proposals.evidence: Turner jvalati gives Hindi jalnā, eastern jarab and Oriya jaḷibā in the intransitive burn family. These are single inflected verbs, kept distinct from Lahnda geminate jall- (*jvalyate) and from transitive kindle forms.
